sultan abdul hamid II.a great man of ummah, he was the firs Muslim leader to establish Islam in japan.

the Ottoman Empire and japan were the only two independent countries in asia, before 1900.they decided to establish friendly relations between them and consequently they started to exchange visits. Muhammad Ali, one of the Sultan Abdul Hamid’s Envoys, visited Japan in 1902 with the intention of building a Yokohama mosque.

the photo: friendship message from emperor meiji of japan to Ottoman Empire sultan abdul hamid II, in 1888.a lot of historical documents show that the emperor of japan was asking sultan abdul hamid II to send Islamic scholars to japan, to teach people of japan about Islam.

Source : Islam in japan
